selection_policy: Keep all medium_v1 and stress_v1 groups.
Keep 6 of 15 groups per final_v1 circuit; cover all five fault levels and each recipe twice.
Keep 3 of 6 groups per supplement_v1 circuit; cover both fault levels and each recipe once.
Among feasible combinations maximize sum of max(AD wall, RC2 wall) across observations.
Tie-break by sum of absolute AD/RC2 wall differences, then fixed SHA256 order.
No method winner, diagnosis quality, optimum label or proof status enters selection.
Keep each physical group and its three observations together; retain original IDs.
caveat: Selection uses observed runtimes and is a development subset, not an independent evaluation. Do not present historic selected-subset performance as an unbiased full-dataset result.
historical_runtime_source_description: Old-server 594-instance paired AD-LS fraction50 and BE-RC2 complete-process wall times; 120s, seed1, six concurrent single-thread tasks.
